title: Only Drivers Need Apply
description: The "Assign as driver" dropdown on the Fleet board is for drivers only — an admin or dispatcher's own email showing up there would let someone accidentally assign a shipment to the wrong kind of account entirely.
successCondition: On /fleet, the "Assign as driver" select's options list contains only the email addresses of accounts with role "driver" (matching GET /api/fleet/drivers) — no admin, dispatcher, or customer email appears among the options.
hints: Cross-check the rendered options against a direct GET /api/fleet/drivers call as your source of truth.
If the seeded data only has one or two drivers, register a couple more via /register with role "driver" to make the check more meaningful.
